result.summary: Found 1 critical accessibility issue in the promotional banner where light text has severely insufficient contrast against the pale green background.

issues.description: The promotional banner text ('3 free deliveries for you' and 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10') uses white and light grey/white text on a very pale mint-green background, making it barely legible.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color (such as dark green or charcoal) on the light background, or darken the banner background so the text meets WCAG AA contrast ratios.
